test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We are waiting __to __the arrival of our cousins from the West.
solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** option to substitute the word '**to**' is '**for**'.
 
• The word '**To**' is a preposition and a versatile little word that can be used to say many things
